Source Han Serif HC ExtraLight (reference face for local tests)

This repository no longer vendors the `.ttf`. Set `PDFCRAFT_ORGCHART_FONT` or
`PDFCRAFT_CJK_FONT` to a single-face TrueType/OpenType file when running tests
or the `equity_chart` example. Collections (TTC) are rejected by this crate.

A suitable face is Source Han Serif HC ExtraLight from Adobe, SIL OFL 1.1.
See OFL.txt in this directory for the license text that applied when the face
was previously checked in beside these notes.
